quizQuestionPool.title: Quiz Question Pool
quizQuestionPool.intro: Hyperion generates multiple-choice questions for every competency of this course and judges each one before you see it. Approve the questions you want to use in quizzes and exclude the ones you do not.

settings.title: Settings

settings.poolGenerationEnabled: Generate overnight for new lecture material

settings.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.
